verdict.rationale: The only first-party sign of natural-language operation is Agent Checkouts: Crossmint runs its own checkout agent, and the docs describe handling its messages and letting 'the user steer the agent' (docs-50, supp-7). That is a narrow, thinly documented conversational surface; everything else in the pack is REST APIs and SDKs. The docs-for-AI-assistants material and llms.txt help developers write code and earn no credit here. missing for 10: a general natural-language interface or agent for operating wallets, payments and other features; clear documentation that checkout steering accepts free-form natural-language commands; independent or hands-on corroboration.
